name: Adafruit QT Py ESP32-S3 (8 MB flash, no PSRAM)
description: Tiny ESP32-S3 in the XIAO footprint with native USB-C, Wi-Fi 4 + BLE 5, 8 MB flash, NeoPixel and STEMMA QT, castellated for direct PCB mounting.
notes: A 4 MB flash + 2 MB PSRAM version is sold as a separate product.
Native USB (UF2 / CircuitPython drive); BOOT button on GPIO0 plus RESET.
13 GPIO = 11 on pads + 2 on the STEMMA QT connector. Battery pads accept up to 6 V.
XIAO-compatible footprint and pad order; 5V pad is VBUS.
Frequently out of stock at Adafruit.
